# Firestore field-type support

<!-- AUTO-GENERATED by `firepact gen-docs` (just gen-docs). DO NOT EDIT. -->

Every Firestore field value type firepact maps, with the read and write
view TypeScript derived from the actual emitter. See [contract.md](contract.md)
for the projection rules and [adr/](adr/) for the decisions.

| Firestore type | Python | read view | write view |
|---|---|---|---|
| String | `str` | `string` | `string` |
| Number | `int` / `float` | `number` | `number` |
| Boolean | `bool` | `boolean` | `boolean` |
| Null | `T \| None` | `string \| null` | `string \| null` |
| Map | `dict[str, T]` | `Record<string, string>` | `Record<string, string>` |
| Array | `list[T]` | `string[]` | `string[]` |
| Array (tuple) | `tuple[A, B]` | `[number, string]` | `[number, string]` |
| Timestamp (server) | `Annotated[datetime, FirestoreServerTimestamp()]` | `Timestamp \| null` | `FieldValue` |
| Timestamp (plain) | `datetime` | `Timestamp` | `Timestamp \| Date` |
| GeoPoint | `Annotated[..., FirestoreGeoPoint()]` | `GeoPoint` | `GeoPoint` |
| Bytes | `bytes` | `Bytes` | `Bytes` |
| Reference | `Annotated[str, FirestoreRef("X")]` | `DocumentReference<X>` | `DocumentReference<X>` |
| Vector | `Annotated[list[float], FirestoreVector()]` | `VectorValue` | `VectorValue` |
| Enum (string) | `StrEnum` / `Literal` | `"a" \| "b" \| (string & {})` | `"a" \| "b"` |

Realtime roots additionally get `{Name}` / `{Name}Write` / `{Name}Update = UpdateData<{Name}Write>`, a read converter (`{name}Converter`, injects `snapshot.id`), and a typed path helper.
